user.description: [Open the live curve preview](/daylight-preview) to see how these settings shape brightness and color temperature over 24 hours. Opening it closes this form, so note your values first.

data_description.update_interval_seconds: How often, in seconds, the daylight coordinator recalculates.

data_description.sunrise_time: Leave blank to use the astronomical sunrise for this location, computed from the latitude, longitude and elevation Home Assistant is configured with. Set it only to override that with a fixed clock time.
data_description.min_sunrise_time: Leave blank for no minimum. When set, a sunrise that lands earlier than this is moved up to it. Applies after the offset, to the astronomical sunrise and to a fixed Sunrise Time alike.
data_description.max_sunrise_time: Leave blank for no maximum. When set, a sunrise that lands later than this is pulled back to it. Applies after the offset, to the astronomical sunrise and to a fixed Sunrise Time alike.
data_description.sunrise_offset_minutes: Minutes to shift sunrise, positive is later.

data_description.sunset_time: Leave blank to use the astronomical sunset for this location, computed from the latitude, longitude and elevation Home Assistant is configured with. Set it only to override that with a fixed clock time.
data_description.min_sunset_time: Leave blank for no minimum. When set, a sunset that lands earlier than this is moved up to it. Applies after the offset, to the astronomical sunset and to a fixed Sunset Time alike.
data_description.max_sunset_time: Leave blank for no maximum. When set, a sunset that lands later than this is pulled back to it. Applies after the offset, to the astronomical sunset and to a fixed Sunset Time alike.
data_description.sunset_offset_minutes: Minutes to shift sunset, positive is later.

data_description.brightness_mode: Shape of the brightness curve around sunrise and sunset.
data_description.brightness_mode_time_dark_minutes: Minutes before/after a sun event the dark-side ramp starts or ends.
data_description.brightness_mode_time_light_minutes: Minutes before/after a sun event the light-side ramp starts or ends.

error.brightness_range_invalid: Minimum brightness must not exceed maximum brightness.
error.color_temp_range_invalid: Minimum color temperature must not exceed maximum color temperature.

init.description: [Open the live curve preview](/daylight-preview) to see how these settings shape brightness and color temperature over 24 hours. Opening it closes this form, so note your values first.

data_description.min_brightness_pct: Lowest brightness percent the curve will output.
data_description.max_brightness_pct: Highest brightness percent the curve will output.

data_description.min_color_temp_kelvin: Warmest color temperature the curve will output.
data_description.max_color_temp_kelvin: Coolest color temperature the curve will output.

data_description.transition: Transition duration, in seconds, sent with each light command.
data_description.adapt_only_on_state_change: Only adapt when a light changes state, instead of on every update.
data_description.manual_control_reset_minutes: Minutes of no manual changes before adaptation resumes automatically.
data_description.separate_turn_on_commands: Send brightness and color temperature in separate commands.
data_description.send_split_delay: Delay, in seconds, between the brightness and color temperature commands.
